import sys
input = sys.stdin.read

MOD = 1000000007
N = 10
M = 25
S = 1048580

def ksm(x, y):
    ans = 1
    while y:
        if y & 1:
            ans = (ans * x) % MOD
        x = (x * x) % MOD
        y >>= 1
    return ans

def init():
    data = input().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    inv = ksm(100, MOD - 2)
    p = [[0] * (n + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]
    idx = 1
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        for j in range(1, n + 1):
            p[i][j] = int(data[idx])
            idx += 1
            p[i][j] = p[i][j] * inv % MOD
    while n < 6:
        n += 1
        p[n][n] = 1
    return n, p

def get_match(x, a, b, ma, vis):
    if x > 3:
        return True
    for i in range(1, 4):
        if not vis[i] and ma[a[x]][b[i]]:
            vis[i] = True
            flag = get_match(x + 1, a, b, ma, vis)
            vis[i] = False
            if flag:
                return True
    return False

def dfs2(x, y, pro, a, b, ma, pts, tot, bin, f, g):
    if x > 3:
        s = 0
        for i in range(1, tot + 1):
            for j in range(1, 4):
                b[j] = pts[i][j]
            vis = [False] * 4
            if get_match(1, a, b, ma, vis):
                s += bin[i - 1]
        f[s] = (f[s] + pro) % MOD
        return
    ma[a[x]][y] = 0
    if y == n:
        dfs2(x + 1, 1, (pro * (MOD + 1 - p[a[x]][y]) % MOD), a, b, ma, pts, tot, bin, f, g)
    else:
        dfs2(x, y + 1, (pro * (MOD + 1 - p[a[x]][y]) % MOD), a, b, ma, pts, tot, bin, f, g)
    ma[a[x]][y] = 1
    if y == n:
        dfs2(x + 1, 1, (pro * p[a[x]][y]) % MOD, a, b, ma, pts, tot, bin, f, g)
    else:
        dfs2(x, y + 1, (pro * p[a[x]][y]) % MOD, a, b, ma, pts, tot, bin, f, g)

def dfs1(x, y, s, n, a, bin, tot, id, sta, pts):
    if y == 3:
        id[s] = tot[0] + 1
        tot[0] += 1
        sta[tot[0]] = s
        for i in range(1, 4):
            pts[tot[0]][i] = a[i]
        return
    if x > n:
        return
    dfs1(x + 1, y, s, n, a, bin, tot, id, sta, pts)
    a[y + 1] = x
    dfs1(x + 1, y + 1, s + bin[x - 1], n, a, bin, tot, id, sta, pts)

def pre(tot, g, bin):
    for i in range(tot[0]):
        for j in range(bin[tot[0]]):
            if j & bin[i]:
                g[j] = (g[j] + g[j ^ bin[i]]) % MOD

def main():
    n, p = init()
    a = [0] * (N + 1)
    b = [0] * (M + 1)
    bin = [1] * (21)
    for i in range(1, 21):
        bin[i] = bin[i - 1] * 2
    for i in range(1, 21):
        bin[i] = bin[i - 1] * 2
    a[1], a[2], a[3] = 1, 2, 3
    ma = [[1] * (n + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]
    pts = [[0] * (4) for _ in range(70)]
    id_map = [0] * 70
    sta = [0] * 70
    tot = [0]
    f = [0] * (1 << 20)
    g = [0] * (1 << 20)
    # Generate all combinations for the first part
    dfs1(1, 0, 0, n, a, bin, tot, id_map, sta, pts)
    a[1], a[2], a[3] = 4, 5, 6
    # First, process the first set
    dfs2(1, 1, 1, a, b, ma, pts, tot[0], bin, f, g)
    for i in range(1 << tot[0]):
        t = 0
        for j in range(1, tot[0] + 1):
            rev = id_map[bin[n] - 1 - sta[j]]
            if i & bin[j - 1]:
                t += bin[rev - 1]
        g[t] = f[i]
        f[i] = 0
    # Generate all combinations for the second part
    a[1], a[2], a[3] = 4, 5, 6
    dfs2(1, 1, 1, a, b, ma, pts, tot[0], bin, f, g)
    pre(tot, g, bin)
    ans = 0
    for i in range(1 << tot[0]):
        ans = (ans + f[i] * g[bin[tot[0]] - 1 - i]) % MOD
    print((1 - ans + MOD) % MOD)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
